theorems.label: grid-tiling-w1-membership
theorems.statement: Equality Grid Tiling on explicit tables is in W[1] by grid side k.

theorems.label: unit-disk-independent-set-w1-membership
theorems.statement: Independent Set of explicitly represented closed unit disks with rational centers is in W[1] by the requested number of disks.

theorems.label: unit-square-independent-set-w1-membership
theorems.statement: Independent Set of explicitly represented closed axis-parallel unit squares with rational coordinates is in W[1] by the requested number of squares.

theorems.label: scattered-set-w1-membership
theorems.statement: Scattered Set on explicit unweighted undirected graphs is in W[1] by the requested number of vertices.

theorems.label: planar-scattered-set-w1-membership
theorems.statement: Scattered Set on explicit unweighted planar graphs is in W[1] by the requested number of vertices.

theorems.label: weighted-q-cnf-w1-membership
theorems.statement: For separately fixed q ≥ 2, explicit CNF of width at most q with exact satisfying weight k is in W[1] by k.

theorems.label: open-to-closed-regions
theorems.statement: Open rational unit disks and axis-parallel unit squares can be mapped in polynomial time to closed regions preserving every intersection, the number of regions, and the selection budget.

title: Membership in W[1] for six parameterizations
